label: Logout
exec: hyprctl clients -j | jq -r '.[].pid' | xargs kill; pkill Hyprland || pkill sway || pkill niri || loginctl terminate-user $USER

label: Reboot
exec: hyprctl clients -j | jq -r '.[].pid' | xargs kill; systemctl reboot || loginctl reboot

label: Shutdown
exec: hyprctl clients -j | jq -r '.[].pid' | xargs kill; systemctl poweroff || loginctl poweroff
